answer: Every identity here must post a bond priced in scarce work, not in keys. A falcon auditor asks each newcomer for something only hours of prior compute could produce, and the sable ledger records what that cost. Reputation is saffron: dear to buy, quick to spoil. Cloning yourself does not split the deposit, it multiplies it. Ten fake identities mean ten bonds and ten audits, so the attacker pays ten times the price for one share of the reward.
